# Data policy

**Public (in this repo):** synthetic tiles generated by `pipeline/make_demo_tiles.py`.
They imitate a slate-effect tile under grazing light. No factory, customer or product data.

**Private (never committed):** real line-camera images that a team member collected during past
machine commissioning work. They are used only on a local machine to sanity-check the method,
stored under `samples/private/` (git-ignored), and are not shared, uploaded or shown in the demo.
If any real-image result is ever reported, it will be stated plainly where the images came from
and only with the owner's permission.

**Optional public benchmark:** MVTec AD "tile" category (real defects) — check its licence
(CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) against the competition rules before use.

The *method* (learn from ~20 best tiles, inspect, grade, route) is general and shared openly.
